title: Walk through study scenarios
summary: Hypothetical cases explain proposed behaviour without claiming workplace results.

sections.label: Illustrative cases
rows: Artifact, checks, first-pass usability, latency and effort.
Clarification/incomplete outcome without invented domain choices.
Conflict surfaced; agreed policy determines response.
Domain check detects error despite parsing.
Explicit outcome/recovery and actual cost recorded.
Repeated request avoids unintended duplicate effects.
Repaired acceptance and effort rather than first-pass success.

sections.label: ELI15
sections.text: An assistant drafts a configuration. The study asks if the draft is useful, which checks find mistakes, when a person must help, and whether the complete process improves time or cost.

sections.label: No implied activation
sections.text: Cases stop at the generated result unless application/execution is separately specified. They do not assume production deployment, a Jenkins pipeline or a country-policy change.

sections.label: Adapt to actual formats
sections.text: Convert relevant cases into reviewed checks. Separate diagnostic failures from the sample estimating routine performance.

basis: Ticket-scoped recommendation; not an implemented workplace capability
confidence: Moderate for fit; workplace benefit unknown

catalog.applicability: Illustrative context. Compare its assumptions with your own work.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
